card.name: Study findings and conclusions wording
card.fires_on: Words inside result or conclusion statements of studies, such as "in" after a drug name before vivo or experiments, and words in a Conclusions section. Also the end of a drug name in no-interaction statements.

modes.label: In after a drug or study subject
modes.description: The word "in" following a drug or vitamin name in a finding, as in "in vivo".
modes.example: DRSP did not inhibit CYP2C19 and CYP3A4<< in>> vivo .

modes.label: Conclusions section text
modes.description: The heading Conclusions or the first words of the conclusion sentences that follow it.
